content: Meanwhile, the common practice for further enhancing the expressiveness of RNNs is to stack multiple RNN layers, each of which has distinct parameter sets (stacked RNN) BIBREF13 , BIBREF14 . In stacked RNNs, the hidden states of a layer are fed as input to the subsequent layer, and they are shown to work well due to increased depth BIBREF15 or their ability to capture hierarchical time series BIBREF16 which are inherent to the nature of the problem being modeled.
